== Biography ==

Lory is one of the creatures residing in Wonderland. Finding itself in the pool alongside a Duck, Dodo, Eaglet, and others, Lory eventually swam to shore with the group. Lory proved to be an opinionated and temperamental creature—when Alice raised questions about age, Lory grew sulky, insisting "I am older than you, and must know better," yet refusing absolutely to reveal its actual years. Lory also displayed considerable sensitivity to certain topics, reacting with visible distaste to the Mouse's recitation of historical matters.

== Relationships ==

'''[[Alice]]''' — acquaintance. Lory engaged Alice in a heated dispute, declaring "I am older than you, and must know better" and stubbornly refusing to disclose its actual age.

'''[[Mouse]]''' — acquaintance. Both were among the creatures gathered at the shore after falling into the pool.
